directive: Eliminate all hardcoded/static dictionary results in research evaluation scripts and replace with 100% live computational model evaluation.

findings.problem: table_8_ood, table_9_gnn, table_10_continual, table_11_fl, and baselines_matrix contained static dictionary metric summaries instead of computing metrics from live model executions.
findings.scientific_impact: Metrics did not directly reflect runtime algorithmic outputs across hyperparameter or dataset changes.
findings.required_fix: Refactor all sections to execute live model predictions on dataset splits, compute actual metrics via sklearn/MetricsCalculator, and record only computed values.

findings.problem: Estimated retained F1 was computed via a linear proxy formula (0.98 - loss * 0.4) rather than running test-set inference on aggregated weights.
findings.scientific_impact: Federated test accuracy did not evaluate actual test data classifications.
findings.required_fix: Execute local and global model inference on non-IID test partitions for each client round to measure empirical F1.

findings.problem: GNN forward pass used randomly initialized un-trained weights for graph scoring.
findings.scientific_impact: GNN representations were stochastic rather than trained on relational topology.
findings.required_fix: Train GNN layers via node-classification / link-prediction cross-entropy on graph edges before inference.
